## 4. Controller / Service / Provider Files

### `lib/src/controller/interpretation_controller.dart` (873 lines)

Core `Notifier<InterpretationState>` managing:
- WebSocket ASR session (connect, reconnect with exponential backoff, config packet)
- `core_audio` mic stream → 1280-byte PCM chunks
- ASR/translation/TTS message handling
- BLE glasses sync (recording state, translation text, sim-inter status)
- Pause/resume, TTS toggle, session timers (2h timeout), history save on exit

Provider: `interpretationControllerProvider` — `NotifierProvider.autoDispose`

Key test hooks: `buildConfigPacket`, `applyAsrResultForTest`, `handleDeviceEventForTest`, `handleBleSessionChangedForTest`, `forceRecordTimeoutForTest`

class SelectedLanguagesNotifier extends Notifier<({int fromId, int toId})> {
  @override
  ({int fromId, int toId}) build() {
    final config = ref.read(interpretationConfigProvider);
    return (fromId: config.fromLanguageId, toId: config.toLanguageId);
  }
  void select({required int fromId, required int toId}) {
    state = (fromId: fromId, toId: toId);
  }
}

final selectedLanguagesProvider =
    NotifierProvider<SelectedLanguagesNotifier, ({int fromId, int toId})>(...);

## Architecture Summary

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    App[App Shell] -->|overrides| Config[interpretationConfigProvider]
    App --> Routes[interpretationRoutes]
    Page[InterpretationPage] --> Controller[InterpretationController]
    Controller --> Audio[core_audio engine]
    Controller --> WSS[WebSocket ASR]
    Controller --> BLE[glassesCommandSender]
  Controller --> History[InterpretationHistoryRepository]
    LangBar[InterpretationLanguageBar] --> LangSvc[InterpretationLanguageService]
    LangSvc --> REST[core_network REST]
```

**Key design points:**
- `autoDispose` controller tears down mic/socket on page pop
- BLE is optional; phone interpretation works without glasses
- Entry matching uses `paragraph_seq + sentence_seq` (not positional)
- App must override `interpretationConfigProvider` and register `InterpretationL10n.delegate`
